vs_iter_6_baseline.interpretation: iter_8 is safe and repeats near iter_6, but the +2 deg WOT spark did not produce a clear power gain. VE smoothing may still improve street part-throttle feel because WOT VE was untouched.

notes: iter_8 = iter_6 base + cruise/part-throttle VE smoothing (RPM 1500-5000, TPS 0-60, WOT VE untouched) + aggressive +2 deg WOT spark at MAP=100 kPa for RPM 4500/5000/5500. Post-flash pulls _38..40 show 0 knock and healthy temps, but average WOT power is slightly below iter_6. Treat iter_8 as safe/street-smoothing candidate, not a WOT power winner.
